paragraph: The department’s operational technology security and cloud infrastructure are supported by a balanced mix of recurring OPEX subscriptions totaling $14,400 annually, alongside targeted project-based engagements. Legacy systems have been rationalized to reduce waste, while critical OT security and compliance needs remain actively funded under flexible monthly models.
